control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: high potential incident - gravity exposure at ML-3201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMBANKMENT_SURVEILLANCE: the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation on ML-3201, M-3201 and VT-3201 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating an impoundment, specifically managing freeboard, beach and decant. ML-3201 (grinding mills) is in service for two-line ball milling. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation was never verified as effective. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 13 April 2026 a high potential incident was recorded on ML-3201, M-3201 and VT-3201 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during an intrusive maintenance task; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
